script_line: Not because the arthritis has gone. Her scan looks exactly the same as it did in March. I have both of them. Because the load is not landing on that band any more.

risks.risk: the two films diverge or change
risks.prevented_by: the two films stay side by side and unchanged; HOLD-C
no writing appearing on the films, no text appearing
